entities.name: Aleksandar Nađfeji
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Aleksandar Nađfeji is a German basketball coach and former player of Serbian descent. Standing at 2.03 m, Nađfeji mainly played as power forward in his career. Originally from Serbia, Nađfeji spent the majority of his playing and coaching career in Germany and later gave up his Serbian citizenship to retain only German nationality. He is best known for his long-standing career in the Basketball Bundesliga (BBL).
